en: I agree with you that we need more time.
es: Coincido contigo en que hace falta más tiempo.
why: Full agreement with nothing taken back: coincido contigo en que.

en: You have a point, but it's very expensive.
es: No te falta razón, pero es muy caro.
why: A point given and then a but is partial agreement.

en: You have some of the point, but not all of it.
es: Algo de razón tienes, pero no toda.
why: Algo de razón tienes gives only part.

en: I agree with you that the plan is good. (to a friend)
es: Coincido contigo en que el plan es bueno.
why: Complete agreement is coincido contigo en que.

en: You have a point; however, we have no money.
es: No te falta razón; ahora bien, no tenemos plata.
why: Ahora bien turns the sentence, so partial agreement.

en: I agree with you that Rosa should decide.
es: Coincido contigo en que Rosa debe decidir.
why: The speaker is fully on your side.

en: He has a point, but he arrived late.
es: No le falta razón, pero llegó tarde.
why: A point then a but is partial.

en: On that you convinced me, but not on the price.
es: En eso me convenciste, pero no en el precio.
why: It gives one point and holds back the rest.

en: I agree with you that the café needs a new menu.
es: Coincido contigo en que el café necesita un menú nuevo.
why: Plain full agreement is coincido contigo en que.
